headline: BOS @ TBR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BOS 3.62 at TBR 4.15, with a projected total of 7.76. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TBR: BOS moved -1.14 runs while TBR moved +0.17, changing the projected margin by -1.30 runs. The projected total fell -0.98, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Drew Rasmussen has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Yandy Díaz, Junior Caminero, Caleb Durbin, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Oliver Dunn, Chandler Simpson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
